updates.unsupported: Updates are only available in the packaged app.
updates.available: Version {version} is available. The portable version is updated by downloading it again.
updates.error: The update check failed. Are you offline?

ProfileSwitcher.label: Profile
ProfileSwitcher.runningTimerText: The timer for “{name}” is stopped and booked before the profile changes.

CreateProfileDialog.title: New profile
CreateProfileDialog.description: Each profile has its own projects, activities and time entries.

UnavailableProfileDialog.missingText: The profile file could not be found or is not a valid Taktra profile. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.
UnavailableProfileDialog.newerVersionText: This profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra and cannot be opened by this version. Update Taktra to use it again. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.
UnavailableProfileDialog.migrationFailedText: This version of Taktra could not update the profile to its file format. The file was not changed, so the previous version of Taktra can still open it. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.

WelcomeView.title: Welcome to Taktra
WelcomeView.text: Create a profile to start tracking your time, or open an existing profile file.
WelcomeView.missingText: The file of the selected profile could not be found or opened. Create a new profile, open a profile file, or remove the profile from the list.
WelcomeView.sampleText: Just want to look around first?
WelcomeView.newerVersionText: The selected profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra. Update Taktra, choose another profile, or remove it from the list.
WelcomeView.migrationFailedText: The selected profile could not be updated to the file format of this Taktra version. The file was not changed. Choose another profile, keep using it with the previous Taktra version, or remove it from the list.

TimerView.title: Timer
TimerView.recentEmpty: Activities you track will show up here for a quick start.
TimerView.discardConfirmText: The running time is not booked and the entry is deleted.
TimerView.help: Start and stop time tracking for an activity here. Recently used activities start with one click, new ones are created when you start the timer. Without opening Taktra, use the quick start from the tray icon.

TrackingView.deleteConfirmText: The time entry is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
TrackingView.help: All entries of a day, that is the time booked on activities, by timer or by hand. Add time you forgot to track and correct entries here. Gaps between entries show time not tracked yet.

TimeEntryDialog.title: New entry
TimeEntryDialog.durationInvalid: Please enter a duration between 1 minute and 24 hours.
TimeEntryDialog.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
TimeEntryDialog.newActivityTags: Tags for the new activity “{name}”. They apply to all of its entries.

TagPicker.label: Tags
TagPicker.description: Tags belong to the activity and apply to all of its entries.

ProjectsView.title: Projects
ProjectsView.empty: No projects yet. Create a project, then book time on its activities.
ProjectsView.deleteConfirmText: The project is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
ProjectsView.help: Projects structure your work and contain the activities you book time on. Activities are created when you track time. Open a project to see its activities and the time booked on them.

ProjectDetailView.subtitle: Project
ProjectDetailView.empty: No activities yet. Activities are created when you track time.
ProjectDetailView.emptyPeriod: No time tracked in this period.

ActivityDetailView.emptyPeriod: No time tracked in this period.
ActivityDetailView.deleteConfirmText: The time entry is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone. If it is the last entry of the activity, the activity is deleted too.

MoveActivityDialog.title: Move “{name}”
MoveActivityDialog.nameDescription: Must be unique in the target project.
MoveActivityDialog.hint: All time entries of this activity move along. Reports and totals of both projects change accordingly, also for past periods.
MoveActivityDialog.clientReplaced: The target project sets its own client: “{from}” is replaced by “{to}”, including time already tracked.

ProjectDialog.clientDescription: Applies to all activities of the project, including time already tracked.
ProjectDialog.clientReplaces: {count, plural, one {# activity has} other {# activities have}} a different client. It is replaced by the client of the project, including time already tracked.
ProjectDialog.clientHandedDown: {count, plural, one {# activity keeps} other {# activities keep}} “{client}” as their client, including time already tracked.

ClientsView.title: Clients
ClientsView.empty: No clients yet. Add clients to evaluate and export your time by who the work was for.
ClientsView.deleteConfirmText: The client is deleted permanently and removed from its projects and activities. This cannot be undone.
ClientsView.help: Who you work for, such as customers or internal departments. Assign them to a project or to single activities, never when booking. Reports and exports can then be filtered by client.

TagsView.title: Tags
TagsView.empty: No tags yet. Tags such as meeting or support show what kind of work your time went into.
TagsView.deleteConfirmText: The tag is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
TagsView.help: Tags describe the kind of work, such as meeting or support, independent of the project. Assign them to activities. Reports then show how much time went into each kind of work.

TagDetailView.subtitle: Tag
TagDetailView.empty: No time has been tracked on activities with this tag yet.
TagDetailView.emptyPeriod: No time tracked on activities with this tag in this period.

TagBadges.more: {count, plural, one {# more tag} other {# more tags}}

ReportsView.title: Reports
ReportsView.empty: No time tracked in this period.
ReportsView.help: Shows how much time went where in a period, grouped by project, tag or client. Use the filters to narrow it down, for example to a single client.

ExportView.title: Export
ExportView.empty: No completed entries in this period.
ExportView.help: Writes all completed entries of a period to a file, for example for billing or other systems. The preview shows what the file will contain.

ReportBreakdown.overlap: An entry counts towards every tag of its activity, so tag shares can overlap and add up to more than 100 %.

miniTimer.title: Mini timer
miniTimer.label: Show mini timer
miniTimer.description: Shows a small always-on-top window with the running timer while Taktra is minimized or covered by other windows.

global.title: Global shortcuts
global.description: Work in every app, also while Taktra runs in the background.
global.quickStartDescription: Search an activity and start its timer.
global.unavailable: This shortcut is already used by another app or the system. Record a different one.

app.title: App shortcuts
app.description: Work while a Taktra window is focused. Single keys are ignored while typing.
app.create: New entry, project, client or tag

UpdatesSettings.title: Updates
UpdatesSettings.label: Check for updates automatically
UpdatesSettings.description: Looks for new versions on GitHub at start and every few hours. Updates are downloaded in the background and installed when you quit Taktra. Without a connection, nothing happens.

ProfileSettingsView.title: Profile settings
ProfileSettingsView.help: A profile is a separate file with all its projects and entries, for example one for work and one for private projects. To back it up, simply copy the file.

ProfileGeneralSettings.nameDescription: Stored in the profile file. Renaming does not change the file name.

DeleteProfileSection.title: Delete profile
DeleteProfileSection.description: Moves the profile file to the trash and removes the profile from Taktra.
DeleteProfileSection.confirmText: The profile file will be moved to the trash. You can restore it from there as long as the trash has not been emptied.

Errors.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: This profile is not known to Taktra.
Errors.PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: The profile file could not be found or opened.
Errors.PROFILE_FILE_EXISTS: A file already exists at this location.
Errors.PROFILE_INVALID: The file is not a valid Taktra profile.
Errors.PROFILE_NEWER_VERSION: The profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra. Update Taktra to open it.
Errors.PROFILE_MIGRATION_FAILED: The profile could not be updated to the file format of this Taktra version. The file was not changed.
Errors.PROJECT_NAME_TAKEN: A project with this name already exists.
Errors.PROJECT_HAS_TIME_ENTRIES: The project has tracked time and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
Errors.ACTIVITY_NAME_TAKEN: This project already has an activity with this name.
Errors.ACTIVITY_HAS_TIME_ENTRIES: The activity has tracked time and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
Errors.TIME_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: The time entry no longer exists.
Errors.TAG_NAME_TAKEN: A tag with this name already exists.
Errors.CLIENT_NAME_TAKEN: A client with this name already exists.
Errors.CLIENT_HAS_TIME_ENTRIES: The client has tracked time and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
Errors.CLIENT_SET_BY_PROJECT: The client is set by the project and cannot be changed for a single activity.
Errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.SHORTCUT_UNAVAILABLE: This shortcut is already used by another app or the system.
Errors.EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED: The file could not be written. Is it still open in another program?
